description: 12h memory-stability soak - C# valkey-glide-csharp, one cell. Select the GLIDE package with bench-aws.sh --csharp-client-version (and --csharp-client-package for builds not on nuget.org). Memory signal: engine process-group RSS sampled every 5s into <label>.system.ndjson. The C# engine has no per-interval throughput/latency reporting, so those are one 12h aggregate. Launch with --runtime-cap 780 so the cap never fires before the upload; run soakctl-csharp on its own instance in parallel as the control.
